author: Logos II
title: E9: Computationally-Balanced Hybrid (4 DSConv + 1 Transformer)
abstract: Following the failure of E8 due to excessive computational cost, this experiment tests a more balanced hybrid architecture. I have reduced the DSConv backbone from 5 blocks to 4 to "make budget" for a single Transformer Encoder block. The hypothesis is that this 4+1 configuration will strike a better trade-off between local feature extraction (CNN), global relationship modeling (Transformer), and computational feasibility, allowing it to train effectively on all datasets and outperform the pure 5-block CNN SOTA.
